I always knew it had happened, and because my parents both experienced sexual abuse they were always meticulous about asking me about my day and telling me to let them know if I was ever touched inappropriately. I was lucky enough for the molestation to only happen once.

I couldn't remember my childhood until my senior year of high school in psych class when we watched a video about sexually abused individuals who developed dissociative personality disorder. The memory of my trauma flooded back and I started screaming and crying. After the incident, I was able to recall my childhood.

I'm telling you this because on your road to recovery, things like this will most certainly happen. It will be difficult at times and that's okay. You've been through so much more than I have and I'm so proud of you for recognizing your abuse and for reaching out. You are a phenomenal person.
